Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C EXECUTIVE ENGINEER

. The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 6. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 5 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses HIGH BACK AUDITORIUM CHAIR WITH DESKLET PU ARMS: Providing and placing in position High Back Audit orium Chair with PU Armrests and Retractable Desklet, complete with all necessary accessories, floor mou nting/grouting arrangements, chemical/mechanical anchors, fasteners and fittings. GROUTING/FLOOR FIXI NG: Chair shall be securely mounted/grouted to the finished auditorium floor using suitable M10 or higher mechanical/chemical anchors, including chemical anchoring system where required, complete with suitabl e base plates and all necessary fixing accessories. SEAT ASSEMBLY: The seat assembly shall comprise mou lded High Resilience (HR) polyurethane foam with suitable M.S. tubular frame insert, upholstered with dura ble fabric. The tubular frame shall be fabricated from Ø19 mm × 1.6 mm thick M.S. ERW round tube, or te chnically equivalent section having equal or higher structural adequacy, with flexible support straps runnin g across the length and width of the frame. The seat shall have an automatic tip-up feature, returning to th e upright position when not in use to facilitate clear row passage. Approximate seat size shall be 450–470 mm (W) × 455–480 mm (D). BACKREST ASSEMBLY: The backrest shall incorporate a suitable flexi-back me chanism and shall comprise moulded HR polyurethane foam over a suitable M.S. tubular frame/support str ucture, upholstered with durable fabric and provided with a durable injection-moulded polymer back cover . The tubular frame shall be fabricated from Ø19 mm × 1.6 mm thick M.S. ERW round tube, or technically equivalent section having equal or higher structural adequacy, with flexible support straps running across the length and width of the frame. Approximate high-back size shall be 450–470 mm (W) × 800–840 mm ( H). HIGH RESILIENCE (HR) POLYURETHANE FOAM: HR polyurethane foam shall be moulded and shall have a density of 45 ± 3 kg/m³, providing suitable resilience, durability and seating comfort. SYNCHRO-SLIDE/FL EXI MECHANISM: Heavy-duty synchro-slide or equivalent mechanism shall be provided to facilitate coordin ated movement of seat and back for comfortable posture and controlled movement, with an effective strok e of 60 ± 5 mm or equivalent functional movement, and shall be smooth, durable and maintenance-friendl y. SIDE PANEL/AISLE PANEL: The chair shall be supported on two structurally adequate side/aisle panel fra mes fabricated from suitable CR/MS steel sheet or equivalent structural material, suitably cladded/upholst ered. Each side panel shall be securely floor-mounted through a minimum 3 mm thick HR/MS steel base pl ate using suitable mechanical/chemical anchors, with minimum two suitable anchors per panel, capable of safely resisting normal service loads. PU ARMREST WITH DESKLET: Armrest shall be made of integral-skin polyurethane (PU) or equivalent durable material having hardness 65 ± 10 Shore A, with reinforced intern al insert and concealed durable hinge/fixing arrangement. The armrest shall be securely connected to the side panel and shall permit smooth and safe operation of the desklet. RETRACTABLE DESKLET: Desklet sha ll be retractable/foldable and fabricated from minimum 18 mm thick pre-laminated particleboard or techni cally equivalent board, with in-situ injection-moulded polypropylene/polymer edging all around or equivale nt durable edge protection. Desklet shall be mounted on a heavy-duty high-pressure die-cast aluminium or equivalent metal support arm through suitable metal bracket/fixing arrangement. The desklet assembly sh all be securely connected to the side panel through a durable connector of suitable engineering polymer s uch as glass-filled nylon or technically equivalent material. Approximate desklet outer dimensions shall be 260–290 mm (W) × 300–330 mm (D). POWDER COATING: All exposed steel components shall be suitably s urface-prepared and epoxy polyester powder coated with minimum 50 microns DFT. FLOORING PRE-REQUI SITE: The auditorium chair shall be suitable for permanent mounting/grouting on the finished auditorium fl

oor, with the fixing system compatible with the actual floor construction and approved installation require ments. APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: High Back; Centre-to-Centre 575–600 mm; Depth in upright position 4 80–520 mm; Overall Width 650–690 mm; Operating/Flexing Depth 600–650 mm; Overall Depth in fully ext ended/occupied position 740–800 mm; Seat Height 450–475 mm; Overall Height 950–1030 mm. All structu ral joints shall be robust and properly finished, and all moving mechanisms shall operate smoothly, safely and without objectionable noise or interference. The complete chair shall be suitable for institutional audit orium use and shall conform to ANSI/BIFMA X5.1-2017 or latest applicable edition, or equivalent internatio nally accepted standard. FIRE SAFETY: The upholstery composite (fabric with foam) shall conform to IS 15 768:2008 (as amended) for resistance to ignition of upholstered composites used in non-domestic furnitur e, and the bidder shall submit a valid test certificate from a NABL-accredited laboratory or valid BIS certific ation/licence, wherever applicable. Bidder shall submit detailed technical datasheet, product catalogue, di mensional drawing, installation details and relevant test/certification documents. Offered chair shall be ne w, unused and current production. Product to be installed with Main & add on concept, vendors are advised to visit Chemistry Department Uni versity of Allahabad before bid submission. . 10. Rate Contract Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 11. Rate Contract Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 12. Rate Contract Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 13. Rate Contract ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 14. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 15. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 16. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection.
